leadText:
Lagoon Town (Japanese: ラーグンタウン Lagoon Town) is an -exclusive location in the Kalos region. It is located between Shalour City and Coumarine City. It has a theater where Pokémon Showcases are held.

 and arranged a meeting there with , who wanted to tell them something. When they met up in Dreaming a Performer's Dream!, Shauna informed them that would give an exhibition performance at the Pokémon Showcase Rookie Class held that day.

After Aria's performance, a ran onto the stage and interrupted the performance of Kayleigh. Serena would later the .
